author: reek
body: Guards the class-F __record-set lift in apps/diagram. Each nested __record-set chain became a let-chain; a mis-threaded chain still compiles but silently drops the earlier writes, leaving a field nobody reads unset. This probe exercises lifted chains whose chapters compile standalone and asserts every write survives in the final value: the first, a middle, and the last write of selection-start-drag (a 5-field chain), and the first and last of diagram-add-node and diagram-add-edge. The many chains in Diagram.codex and Canvas are inspection-verified (their chapters do not yet compile); all are structurally identical same-object threads.
